Class JsonObject

java.lang.Object
gate.lang.json.JsonObject
All Implemented Interfaces:
JsonCollection, JsonElement, Serializable, Map<String, JsonElement>
public class JsonObject extends Object implements Map<String, JsonElement>, JsonCollection
Represents a JSON object as a java Map.

This class provides a comprehensive API for creating, manipulating, and converting JSON objects in Java. It implements the Map interface with String keys and JsonElement values, allowing standard Java collection operations.

The class supports:

  • Type-safe getters and setters for primitive types
  • Conversion to and from Java objects
  • JSON parsing and formatting
  • Optional-based value retrieval to handle missing keys safely
Author:
Davi Nunes da Silva
